title: Valley Forge Village marker
description: Village of Valley Forge. Village settled by the workers at Iron Forge begun in 1742. The forge and part of the village were burnt by the British Army in 1777. Washington's quarters during the winter of 1777 - 1778 were in the Isaac Potts house, a part of the original village.
